angle.hook: A rumour says Pokémon Winds and Waves were planned for November 2026 and pushed a full year to November 2027
angle.why_now: MyNintendoNews relayed the claim on 8 November, two days after CentroLeaks posted it, and the original November 2026 window would have been this month.
angle.what_it_means_here: If true the official 2027 window is the delayed one, but no date is official, the source is anonymous and neither Nintendo nor The Pokémon Company has commented.
angle.payoff: what is official: 2027, Nintendo Switch 2, no date

new_vs_27_sep: The 27 Sep post was a leak about game details; this is a new claim about the schedule (the delay), first reported 6 Nov.
